just wanted to leave a review to say how fantastic this surgery is. From reception to the GPs, the whole team are kind, compassionate and genuinely helpful. Every interaction I’ve had has been handled with care and respect. The customer service is top notch, both over the telephone and via email  queries are responded to quickly and professionally, which makes such a difference.

Since moving to this practice, I’ve felt truly listened to and supported. For the first time, I felt like my concerns were taken seriously and not brushed aside. One of the GPs took the time to really hear me, ask the right questions, and follow things through properly. Because of that, I was finally able to receive the diagnosis I had been needing for a long time.

I now have the right support in place, and it has made such a positive difference to my wellbeing and daily life. It means so much to feel believed and supported by your GP.

I’m incredibly grateful to be under the care of such a professional, understanding and dedicated team. Thank you for everything you do it truly makes a
